id.description: Stable id (referenced by fragment start/end/divider anchors).

from.description: Source participant id. Ignored when `found` is true (message originates from a boundary dot).

to.description: Target participant id (== from for a self-message). Ignored when `lost` is true (message vanishes at a boundary dot).

style.description: Legacy: solid (call) or dashed (return). Prefer `arrow`. A bare `style:'dashed'` is treated as arrow:'reply'.

arrow.description: UML arrowhead: sync = solid line + filled head (synchronous call, default); async = solid line + open head (asynchronous signal); reply = dashed line + open head (return/response).

activate.description: Force-start an execution/activation bar on the `to` participant at this step (explicit-activation mode). If any message sets activate/deactivate, auto-activation is disabled and bars are driven only by these flags.

deactivate.description: Force-close the innermost open activation bar on the `from` participant at this step (typically on a reply).

create.description: UML create message: the `to` participant is instantiated here — its header drops down to this row and its lifeline starts at this step (nothing drawn above).

destroy.description: UML destroy message: the `to` participant is destroyed here — its lifeline ends with an X at this step.

found.description: Found message: origin is a filled boundary dot (unknown/external sender); `from` is ignored for geometry.

lost.description: Lost message: target is a filled boundary dot (unknown/external receiver); `to` is ignored for geometry.

tone.description: Accent for the arrow when it is the active step (default accent/orange).

badge.description: Semantic badge shown on the step: gate (can abort), keyless, async, sync, phase, fail.

title.description: Narration-panel heading for this step (falls back to `label`).

flow.description: Small sub-line under the panel title (e.g. 'SA/Dev → CodeCommit').

proof.description: Panel 'proof' line: either free text (inline `code` supported) OR a structured source ref {repo,path,ref,lines,url,text} rendered as a clickable link to the exact file@ref/lines.

repo.description: Repository base URL (e.g. 'https://github.com/aws-samples/sample-architecture-diagram-mcp-server'). Combined with path/ref/lines to build a blob link.

ref.description: Commit SHA, tag, or branch to pin the link to (default 'main'). Pin to a commit for a truly stable reference.

lines.description: Line number, 'start-end' string, or [start,end] — appended as #L.. so the link opens on the exact lines.

url.description: Explicit link URL — overrides repo/path/ref/lines construction.

text.description: Link label (defaults to path:lines or the URL).

code.description: Optional fenced snippet under the description (preserves whitespace).

codeLabel.description: Uppercase label on the code block header (e.g. 'handler.py', 'asl').

codeBlocks.description: Several files on this event, each a collapsible block with its own header, copy button and chevron (the first open, the rest collapsed unless `collapsed` says otherwise). Use instead of code/codeLabel.

label.description: File name or title shown on the block header, e.g. 'eks.tf'.

lang.description: Language tag on the header (default: from the label's extension).

collapsed.description: Start collapsed (default: only the first block starts open).

codeSplit.description: Opt-in: split `code` at '===== name =====' lines into collapsible blocks. Without it a single code string is never split.
